title: Z Group — Bilingual Real Estate Corporate Website & CMS
summary: A bilingual (EN/AR) corporate website and admin content management system that lets a real estate development company autonomously manage projects, marketing pages, and leads.
description: Z Group is a full digital ecosystem for a premier real estate developer, combining a public marketing site with a private admin console. Visitors can browse active, upcoming, and previous projects with galleries, floor plans, amenities, location maps, and construction timelines; submit project inquiries, register interest on landing pages, and apply for careers. The authenticated admin dashboard gives the marketing team complete control over project listings, a modular drag-and-drop landing page builder, every site section and SEO setting, and all form submissions — removing the need for developer intervention for every content change.
highlights: Engineered a modular, typed section-based landing page builder (hero, stats, content, features, gallery, CTA) with reorder/enable/disable controls persisted as a typed union of MongoDB models.

Built a custom weighted SEO scoring engine (SeoAnalyzer) with 8 rule checkers (title, description, headings, keyword density, images, URL, content structure, readability) that scores and recommends fixes for both English and Arabic content.

Designed a bilingual-first data model with localized {en, ar} strings throughout, an RTL-aware frontend, and an aggregated analytics dashboard powered by MongoDB aggregation pipelines across 11 collections.
features: Bilingual public site (English/Arabic) with next-intl i18n, locale routing, and RTL support
Project portfolio with gallery images/videos, floor plans, amenities, nearby places, partner logos, and location maps
Under-construction project pages with construction progress timelines and image sets
Previous projects showcase with reorderable item management
Admin dashboard with portfolio stats, donut/bar charts, recent activity, and quick actions
Drag-and-drop landing page builder with modular content sections and draft/publish workflow
Site settings manager for home, about, milestones, achievement video, footer, and page SEO
Integrated real-time SEO analyzer with weighted scores and actionable recommendations
Form submission management for project inquiries, landing page interest, careers (CV upload), and about-us contacts
JWT-based admin authentication with bcrypt password hashing and admin-only RBAC middleware
challenges: Modeling a flexible yet type-safe section-based page system: a discriminated union of section models (Hero, Stats, Content, Features, Gallery, CTA) with per-section props, ordering, and enabled flags on both the API and the client renderer.

Implementing a locale-aware weighted SEO analysis engine that evaluates content quality independently for English and Arabic, computing a live score from passed/total rule weights and surfacing severity-ranked issues in the editor.

Orchestrating a single aggregated dashboard endpoint that concurrently counts, trends, and snapshots data across 11 MongoDB collections using Promise.all and aggregation pipelines while keeping consistent response shapes for the charting UI.
architecture: Next.js 16 App Router frontend with next-intl locale routing (en/ar) and RTL support, consuming an Express 5 REST API backed by MongoDB (native driver) for content with PostgreSQL via pg for relational data. JWT access tokens in httpOnly cookies with bcrypt hashing protect admin routes, Multer handles media/CV uploads served as static files, and Zod validates all payloads.

title: Shopify–Shippo Bridge
summary: A Shopify App that connects merchants' stores to the Shippo shipping API for automated order fulfillment, label purchasing, and shipment tracking.
description: A full-stack Shopify App that bridges Shopify stores to the Shippo shipping platform. Merchants install the app via OAuth, and incoming Shopify orders are automatically ingested through webhooks. From there, the app handles the full fulfillment workflow: creating and validating addresses in Shippo, comparing shipping rates, purchasing labels, requesting carrier pickups, and syncing fulfillment status back to Shopify. A configurable shipping rules engine lets merchants automate rate selection based on order value, weight, or delivery window.
highlights: Shopify OAuth integration with JWT session management, httpOnly cookie auth, and automatic token refresh with request queuing
Automated order ingestion via Shopify webhooks that creates validated Shippo addresses and maps line items in a single pass
Bulk carrier pickup processing using RabbitMQ for background job queues with real-time progress streaming over SSE via Redis pub/sub
Shipping rules engine that evaluates prioritized conditions (order value, weight, always-apply) to auto-select the cheapest qualifying rate within a delivery window
features: Shopify OAuth app installation with scoped access and webhook registration
Automatic order ingestion from Shopify orders/create webhook with Shippo address validation
Shipment creation with Shippo rate comparison and label purchasing
Configurable shipping rules with prioritized conditions, max delivery days, and drag-to-reorder
Bulk pickup requests with background processing and live SSE progress updates
Address management with Shippo validation and local storage
Shipment tracking with status updates synced back to Shopify fulfillments
Dark/light theme with system preference detection
challenges: Coordinating asynchronous bulk pickup jobs across RabbitMQ, Redis pub/sub, and SSE streaming while handling partial failures gracefully
Mapping and syncing shipment tracking statuses between Shippo and Shopify's fulfillment system, including creating fulfillments and fulfillment events on demand
Designing the Shopify OAuth lifecycle with short-lived access tokens, long-lived refresh tokens, and a frontend interceptor that queues and retries requests on 401
architecture: React SPA frontend communicating with an Express backend, backed by MongoDB for persistence, Redis for pub/sub (SSE streaming), and RabbitMQ for background job processing. Integrates with Shopify's REST/GraphQL APIs and Shippo's REST API for shipping operations.
